title: Innovative Approach in Tuberculosis Care in Armenia
brief_summary: Randomized trial tests effectiveness of self-administered drug intake by empowered TB patients - supervised by a trained family member and supported by medical counseling and reminders - to improve treatment adherence and treatment success rates, and thereby forestall TB and MDR-TB epidemics.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of drug-sensitive TB
* Age 18 years old and above
* Understanding and reading in Armenian
* Completion of the intensive treatment phase

Exclusion Criteria:

* Involvement in the Home Based TB Treatment Program of the National TB Control Office
